notes.title: Feel the road, feel the speed- latest update available now!
notes.notes:
New update including:

Updates:
Updated road feel and handling.
Enhanced car v car and car v scenery collisions.
AI now slip, slide and glide around the track. And make mistakes too!
Optimised AI racing lines and intelligence.

Fixes:
Fixed glitch to camera when crashing.
Fixed external camera not being restored when exiting the pit lanes.

notes.title: Core Update- Gameplay- AI- Graphics & Slip Streaming returns
notes.notes:
Updates:
Gameplay-
Complete revision of AI for closer racing
Additional enhancements to AI avoiding the player where possible
Increase in effect of slip streaming (although still subtle). All cars in AI now slip stream (AI slip streaming disabled in Rookie mode
Cars engine power rebalanced throughout the top runners.

GFX-
Internal and external cameras updated

Tracks-
Optimised racing lines for:
Hatch Hill
Cliff Top GP
Cliffs Edge
London Palace GP
Beach Side Tour 

Difficulty-
Rookie is easier/ normal more balanced/ pro harder/ pro ++ very hard-

Tyres now more defined so you can see them spinning

Extra scenery in Cliff Top GP and Bounty Run
Skid smoke now triggers only when tyres are really slipping
External camera updated

Gameplay:
AI track navigation improved
AI avoidence improved
Volcano Island grid condensed to make it winnable in Pro
Purple/ Orange and Black cars tuned

Pits and Damage:
Car (player and AI ) speed limited when damage is critical
Pit lane slows player and AI 
Repair strips do not slow the car but only add a tiny bit of health for as long as the car is right over the str

notes.title: New Major Patch Live
notes.notes:
Latest Patch Notes:

v0.3(674)
OPTIONS:
* Fixed stuck volume control

UI General:
* Alt Tab does not break game
* Allow skipping of Splash Screen on second play
* Sound off and pause when game looses focus

In Race
* Paused screen defaults selection to restart race
* Colliders fixed Colosseum, Bay Town, Crystal Palace, Cliff Top GP
* Bridge collider fixed (Splash Wave)
* Race complete does not stick with car
* AI does not crash on race complete
* Crash Cam no longer goes under the track sometimes

Pretty Stuff
* Additional animation added to Splash Wave
* Additional SFX added to Cliffs End and Skull Island
* Added missing drivers

Difficulty/ AI

* Reduction in amount and Severity of AI overtaking in corners
* Tuning to collision severity
* Award of stars revised based on selected difficulty
* Car weight and stability increased
* Timer extended Bay Town

APPLIED but NOT confirmed :

* Steam Deck saves transferring to PC and visa versa

Additional Changes:

* Adjusted UI elements
* Adjusted bloom to make text more readable, and more impact on 3D sources (Modern    GFX mode)
* Fixed crash cam glitch
* Removed exploding player on restart
* Fixed levitating AI car Glitch
* UI accept/ cancel resized as too small (menu)
* Car Ahead/ Behind moved up- race Canvas so as not to obstruct view
* Adjustment made to crash initialisation 
* Analogue throttle restored
* Slip Stream Power Reduced
* Fix to Triassic Park event collider
* Reduced comparative volume of 3D ambient SFX
* Improved AI avoidance
* Fixed AI power bug
* Fix in for external events (Triassic Cove)
* Adjusted Ambient sound
* Fixed miss Auto/ Manual Gear Select 
* Fixed path finding - Crystal Palace and Indie GP 
* Fix to Gladiator materials
* Fix to AI power application


Working on:

* Switching Resolution/ V-sync requires restart to apply
* Unable to cancel unwanted resolution settings
* Add controller layouts to options

notes.title: First Major Update/ Patch On its Way soon!
notes.notes:
Huge thank you for all your support and feedback in the first week of Early Access. We have listened, and are working hard on the first update, which will focus around bugs and gameplay tweaks and rebalancing.

A further announcement will follow, with more detail on items included in the update once the release date is confirmed.

Thanks again for all your awesomeness! 🏁🏁🏁❤️
